# Gianluigi Vitale

> Gianluigi Vitale researches ML systems and LLM safety, with publications at NeurIPS 2026 and MLSys 2026.

Personal research portfolio. The HTML page is the primary source; the Markdown edition contains its English text. The HTML interface also offers an Italian translation.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio text](https://gianluigivitale.github.io/portfolio/index.md): Research, publications, service, experience, education, and contact details.
- [Official website](https://gianluigivitale.github.io/portfolio/): Original HTML portfolio.
